== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Glossary defines target types and defense value. The first PC state adds “any” to the immunity clause. The later full face and printable slip also adjust the deployment phrase and duration wording. The two existing images are placed with the matching published states.

* Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=89|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 89.
* [[:File:CloudCity-L-lukesblasterpistol-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face for unchanged lore and attributes]].
* Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=32 Internet Archive].
* Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=31|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 31.
* Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=121|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 121.
* [[:File:CC-L-lukesblasterpistol-errata-hires.webp|High-resolution face matching the June 2017 wording]].
* [[:File:CC-L-lukesblasterpistol.gif|Later PC full face marked D-E1]].
* Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/vkit/cards/standard/Lukes%20Blaster%20Pistol%20(Errata)/image.png printable errata slip], same wording as the full face.
* Players Committee, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/a5f208b0482cefe27c03ec936fa07485dcde2c6d/Light.json card-data record], entry 1603, wording recorded by 26 December 2025.
